# Science Forums

> > A community-driven science discussion platform covering physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, and theoretical sciences with dedicated forums for homework help, speculations, and interdisciplinary debate.

Science Forums hosts active discussions across scientific disciplines, from classical physics and relativity to genetics and synthetic biology. The community includes educators, researchers, and students engaging in both rigorous scientific discourse and exploratory speculations, with notable contributors like swansont, Mordred, and studiot.

## Key Topics

- Physics (Classical, Relativity, Theoretical)
- Chemistry (Inorganic, Organic)
- Genetics and Synthetic Biology
- Mathematics and LaTeX
- Programming (C, C++, Visual Studio)
- Homework Help and Science Education
- Speculations and Hypotheses
- Natural Selection and Darwin
- Einstein Field Equations
- Biosecurity and Genomic Models
- AI and ChatGPT Discussions
- Dunning-Kruger Effect
- Community Guidelines and FAQ

## Core Science Forums

- [Forums - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net): Main forum index with science discussion categories and announcements
- [Sciences - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/80-sciences): Sciences category index covering physics, chemistry, math, and biology
- [Physics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/6-physics): Physics forum covering classical, quantum, relativity, and theoretical physics
- [Chemistry - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/5-chemistry): Chemistry forum with inorganic, organic, and applied chemistry subforums
- [Genetics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/20-genetics): Genetics forum: DNA replication, Mendelian genetics, gene expression topics
- [Mathematics - Page 2 - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/38-mathematics/page/2): Mathematics forum page 2: analysis, calculus, algebra discussions

## Physics Specializations

- [Relativity - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/10-relativity): Relativity forum: special and general relativity, Einstein field equations
- [Classical Physics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/8-classical-physics): Classical physics discussions: forces, gravity, acceleration, mechanics
- [Modern and Theoretical Physics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/18-modern-and-theoretical-physics): Modern physics forum: Planck units, theoretical physics discussions

## Speculations and Community

- [Speculations - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/29-speculations): Speculations forum for hypothetical scientific ideas with evidence requirements
- [The Lounge - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/3-the-lounge): The Lounge: off-topic discussions, book talk, community forum
- [Politics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/34-politics): Politics forum: political discussions with FAQ and recommended reading

## Learning Resources

- [Homework Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/35-homework-help): Homework help forum: academic assistance, not answers provided
- [Mathematics Tutorials - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/88-mathematics-tutorials): Math tutorials from Centre for Innovation in Maths Learning resources
- [Computer Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/forum/56-computer-help): Computer help forum: tech support, troubleshooting, Windows and Office

## Programming and Computer Science

- [About C language - Computer Science - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/115692-about-c-language): C programming help: web development with HTTP servers and socket library
- [About data type in programming - Computer Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/121894-about-data-type-in-programming): Programming help: understanding data types in Perl and Python
- [How to write Assembly Language Code? - Computer Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/119679-how-to-write-assembly-language-code): Assembly language help: x86 programming with Visual Studio tutorials
- [how to code apps - Computer Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/108664-how-to-code-apps): App development help: C#, Visual Studio, beginner programming resources

## Optional

- [Mental Momentum (short essays about mind and brain) - Speculations - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/119001-mental-momentum-short-essays-about-mind-and-brain): Mental Momentum: essays on cognitive science and thinking processes
- [about veganism - Ethics - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/115459-about-veganism): Ethics discussion: veganism, sustainability, and future food resources
- [Computer Organization - Solution Walkthrough Help - Homework Help - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/113934-computer-organization-solution-walkthrough-help): Computer organization homework: cache memory and set-associative mapping help
- [-Ous and -ic ?? - Inorganic Chemistry - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/22760-ous-and-ic): Chemical nomenclature: -ous/-ic acid naming and oxidation states explained
- [About combining elements together... - Inorganic Chemistry - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/121588-about-combining-elements-together): Inorganic chemistry: combining thorium, silver, silicon via sintering
- [About Me - The Lounge - Science Forums](https://scienceforums.net/topic/125930-about-me): Personal introduction: athlete aspirations and learning genetics with ADHD
